claude.v1v2Help:
V1 vs V2 Differences:

[V1 - Query Mode]
• Each message spawns a new CLI process and rebuilds from JSONL
• Cache efficiency ~25% (high token waste)
• Supports: effort, plugins, systemPrompt
• Stable, fully featured

[V2 - Session Mode]
• Persistent session, no process restart between messages
• Cache efficiency ~84% (significant token savings)
• Does NOT yet support: effort, plugins, systemPrompt
• Experimental, may have limitations

V2 is recommended for cost-sensitive or long conversations.

portInUse.title: BAT server port is already in use
portInUse.body: The BAT server inside WSL cannot use this port (EADDRINUSE). In Mirrored networking mode Windows and WSL share localhost, so a port Windows already uses (for example this BAT's own remote server) is unavailable to WSL. Retry picks another port that is free on Windows; if you specified the port, choose a different one.

warning.networkNat: WSL is using NAT networking. No change is needed: Windows reaches the BAT server on localhost through WSL's localhostForwarding (on by default). Only if the connection test fails, switch WSL to Mirrored mode or connect with the distro's IP address instead.
warning.networkMirroredPendingRestart: .wslconfig sets networkingMode=mirrored, but WSL is still running in NAT mode — the setting has not taken effect yet. Run `wsl --shutdown` in PowerShell (this stops ALL running WSL distros) and retry. Setup can continue in NAT mode meanwhile.
warning.networkMirroredUnsupported: .wslconfig sets networkingMode=mirrored, but this Windows version does not support Mirrored mode (requires Windows 11 22H2 or later), so WSL fell back to NAT. Setup continues in NAT mode; localhost still works through localhostForwarding.
warning.networkMirroredNotApplied: .wslconfig sets networkingMode=mirrored, but WSL is running in NAT mode. Either the setting has not taken effect yet — run `wsl --shutdown` in PowerShell (this stops ALL running WSL distros) — or this Windows version does not support Mirrored mode (requires Windows 11 22H2 or later). Setup can continue in NAT mode.
warning.networkUnverified: WSL reports networking mode "{{mode}}". BAT has only been verified with NAT and Mirrored, so the connection test may fail in this mode.
warning.connectFailedNat: WSL is in NAT mode and connecting to localhost failed. Check that localhostForwarding is not disabled in .wslconfig, switch WSL to Mirrored mode (then run `wsl --shutdown`), or connect with the distro's IP address instead.

warning.containerPortExposed: Container {{name}} publishes the BAT server port on all host interfaces ({{hostIps}}), so other machines on your network can reach it. It was created before BAT bound Docker ports to 127.0.0.1 only. To fix it, run this wizard again with "Create new" (the new container is published on 127.0.0.1 only), then remove the old container yourself with docker rm -f {{name}} once you no longer need its data. BAT will not change or delete it.
warning.containerLegacyImage: Container {{name}} runs a BAT server image built before the Docker networking fix, so the server cannot be reached through the published port. Rebuild the image (npm run build:docker-image) and run this wizard again with "Create new". BAT will not change or delete the old container.
